rawContent: #AnnibyniaethNawr, #IndependenceNow: and #BlackLivesMatter. If the #WelshIndependence movement was inclusive, there wouldn't be a need for a person of colour led #YesCymru group. Our hands have been forced into the creation of this group, specifically, along these lines.

Plus, you could also say that "conflict" has been there for some time: if race doesn't matter, why are topics on equality, diversity, racism+anti racism routinely ignored by the Yes Cymru movement? e.g., look @ how long YC took 2 publicly state support for #BlackLivesMatter

@edwgwilym For example, Yes Cymru were publicly badgered and asked about why they did not profess support for #BlackLivesMatter and we, along with others, have heard of allegations of bullying directly towards #Black #Asian and #Minority #Ethnic women from Yes Cymru branches....

@Cymdeithas @undodcymru prominent organisations in the Welsh public sphere, organised an all-white panel such as this in light of global efforts by #BlackLivesMatter activists and #Black, #Asian and #Minority #Ethnic communities with racism as one of its topics. https://t.co/Ut8mmWHlCw
#BritishEmpire is trending on twitter: and so is #BlackLivesMatter. We want to take this moment to raise awareness of the the nature Wales shares with the British Empire 1/ https://t.co/kWzZwqxWvG

It is in the union's best interests to pit Welsh people against each other. It's in the union's best interests for parties in Wales to continue cultures of institutional whiteness, lip service to diversity and meaningless statements on #BlackLivesMatter without real action 8/

#BlackLivesMatter. #AllBlackLivesMatter. #AllBlackLivesAlwaysMatter. An #IndependentWales will seek to dismantle the structures- and people- that enable institutional racism: the same institutional racism that's woven and embedded in #Wales. 12/
